- [`ConfigHandler.cs` lines 98–101](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/.r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Handler/ConfigHandler.cs?L98-L101): `domainMatcher` defaulting commented out.
- [`Utils.cs` line 395–396](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/.r/github.com/sg-evals/2dust-v2rayN@b48037b7579ab524c106c555cce165e089ebf1dc/-/blob/v2rayN/v2rayN/Tool/Utils.cs?L393-L396): `HttpUtility.UrlEncode` replaced by `Uri.EscapeDataString` with the old line retained as a comment.
